description: Complete the OAuth 2.0 PKCE sign-in: exchange the authorization code for mobile API tokens and load them into this server. Use immediately after the user finishes the `auth_start` flow in the browser. Pass the whole `alza://identity?code=...&state=...` redirect URL as `code` (state is then read from it), or the bare `code` plus `state` — never a password and never a refresh token here. Fails if the state does not match a pending `auth_start` session (start over from `auth_start` in that case). Side effect: replaces the token set currently loaded in this process; afterwards account tools such as `cart`, `profile`, and `order` are authenticated.

code.description: Authorization code from the `alza://identity` redirect (the `code` query parameter), or the full redirect URL.

state.description: State value returned by `auth_start`; must match the pending PKCE session exactly. Optional when `code` is the full redirect URL.

name: auth_exchange

outputSchema.description: Raw Alza envelope. err 0/1/113 (number; an HTML error-page string was observed once), msg string-or-null, data plus operation-specific top-level keys (e.g. basket, items, form).

title: Exchange Alza OAuth code
